en.adEngramDesc: Cross-session long-term memory: graph · hybrid retrieval · flywheel
en.adRainbowDesc: A flowing rainbow marquee border for the chat composer
en.balanceLowBody: {name} balance {balance}, ~{days} days left, please top up
en.balanceStaleNotice: Balance refresh is slow — the figures below come from the last completed query
en.bandPinHint: click to pin to the composer
en.budgetHint: Set a monthly cap for projections and tier alerts
en.budgetSummary: Used {used} / {total} this month; warn at 80%, pulse red at 100%
en.budgetTierBody: This month {cost} reached {pct}% of the budget {budget}
en.cardDisplayHint: Switch the bottom-left billing card between cost and token usage, and pick the figure range (sparkline follows; the popover is unaffected). The day-over-day badge can be hidden here.
en.cellEstimateHint: No pay-as-you-go charge recorded for this row (subscription routes are not billed per call); amount is a catalog-price estimate
en.densityHint: Compact shrinks row height and padding, comfortable adds room; applies instantly
en.emptyHint: Run your first conversation and per-provider usage and cost breakdown will appear here automatically
en.floatNoTargets: No subscription selected — pick some in Settings.
en.floatWindowHint: Usage summary floating on the footer card; Combined=current style, Subscription cards=one quota card at a time (switchable).
en.footer: Polls every 30s · local dsh sessions only
en.kpiDescAvgCost: Total cost ÷ total calls within the selected range — the average cost per call.
en.kpiDescCacheHit: Cache-hit tokens ÷ total input tokens. Higher hit rate means lower input cost (cache reads are ~1/10 the miss price).
en.kpiDescCalls: LLM calls within the selected range (web-search estimates excluded).
en.kpiDescIo: Input tokens ÷ output tokens. A high ratio usually means long context / multi-turn reuse.
en.kpiDescPeak: The day with the most processed tokens (input + output) in the range.
en.kpiDescReasoning: Reasoning tokens ÷ output tokens. A reasoning model's thinking is billed and included in output.
en.kpiDescTokens: Total tokens = input + output. Cache reads/writes are already part of input and are not double-counted (issue #85).
en.liveCostBarHint: Live cost bar beside the composer; hover for details
en.modelBudgetHint: Set a monthly cap per model (CNY); alerts fire once each at 80% / 100%. Empty = unlimited.
en.motionHint: Off freezes all entrance and data-update animations; basic interaction feedback remains
en.noteBand: Peak and off-peak prices differ; off-peak is roughly half price.
en.noteCache: Cache hits are billed at the cache rate, cutting cost.
en.noteSource: Prices come from the live rate + model catalog; unlisted models count as 0 and are flagged.
en.peakAlertDescOff: About to enter off-peak hours — price halves, ideal for large batches
en.peakAlertDescOffZhipu: Off-peak soon — Coding Plan credits will be deducted at 50% of base credits
en.peakAlertDescPeak: About to enter peak hours — prices rise, plan long tasks ahead
en.peakAlertDescPeakZhipu: Peak hours soon (weekdays 14:00–18:00) — Coding Plan credits will be deducted at full rate
en.peakAlertHint: Alert before a tier switch, optionally via system notification
en.perfChartEmpty: No model selected or no data for this metric
en.perfHint: Per model & per hour; estimated samples are tool-continuation steps
en.pricingTip: DeepSeek list rates: V4.1 Flash off-peak ¥1 miss / ¥0.02 cache-hit / ¥4 output; V4 Pro off-peak ¥4.5 miss / ¥0.15 cache-hit / ¥13.5 output; peak = 2× off-peak. Weekday 9-12 / 14-18 bills at peak, all other times (weekends included) at off-peak; billed at call time.
en.promoOpenEnded: End date not announced; billed at the discounted rate until further notice, then list price resumes
en.promoUntil: Promo price until {date}, then list price resumes automatically
en.rechargeHint: Open the vendor's official top-up page
en.reconcileDrift: Detected {provider} official balance moved {spent}, this panel recorded {today}; the gap usually comes from other tools or APIs consuming too
en.roleHint: Estimated: output priced exactly, input split by message size
en.roundsHint: Last {count} rounds · bar tops show amount · fill = peak/off-peak
en.searchEstimateHint: Includes estimated cost of {count} web-search requests (~{each} each; no usage events logged, per-call estimate; tune via searchCallEstimateCny)
en.siteListDisplayHint: Hide "unidentified" placeholder rows in the relay quota list
en.staleLedgerNotice: {count} sessions use legacy-algorithm archives (logs deleted); attribution may be off
en.staleSnapshotNotice: Usage is being recomputed; the figures below come from the last completed calculation (session titles may lag the workspace)
en.subscriptionNoApi: Provider does not offer a usage API
en.subscriptionsStale: Subscription refresh failed — showing cached data
en.tierAlertEnterOff: Off-peak pricing (50% off) starts in {minutes} min
en.tierAlertEnterOffZhipu: Zhipu off-peak in {minutes} min — credit burn drops to 50%
en.tierAlertEnterPeak: Peak pricing (2x) starts in {minutes} min — non-urgent calls can wait
en.tierAlertEnterPeakZhipu: Zhipu peak hours in {minutes} min — Coding Plan credits burn at full rate
en.title: Usage
en.unknownChannelHint: Channel is not registered in the plugin config; the spending party cannot be verified, so cost stays out of the totals while usage is still counted.
en.unpricedHint: {count} models not priced; their cost counts as 0
en.unreadableFormatNotice: {count} of them use a session format this host cannot read: newer formats recover after a host upgrade; legacy formats (e.g. v0/v3) need a one-time migration
en.unreadableNoLedgerNotice: {count} of them have no archived history and are not counted at all
en.unreadableNotice: Usage from {count} sessions is not fully counted (raw logs untouched; no data lost)
en.usageStatsToolHint: Lets the model query usage/cost inside a conversation; it consumes context per request, so keep it off for coding (takes effect immediately)
en.userPricesHint: Enter actual per-1M-token prices; main views are re-costed. Pick a model key from the dropdown candidates. Leave source empty for the model default, or enter a relay origin (protocol optional) to price only that source. Fill all three off-peak fields for peak/off-peak estimation; leave them empty for flat pricing.
